nav.title: Asnulfu n umyawas AI
nav.subtitle: Tallalt s waṭas n tutlayin d ubrid n ufesri s ufus n ufgan.

stats.providerQualificationNote: Tutlayin yettwaseknen s wudem asuf ḥasab

customer.title: Bdu adiwenni
customer.consentText: Qebleɣ ad yettwaxdem wadiwenni s umessuf AI. Iḍrisen ttwawḍen send uḥraz.
customer.startChat: Bdu adiwenni n uḍris s tɣellist
customer.setupHint: Ur yezmir ara alamma amseḍfir yewwi tigejdit n uɛqed d umessuf AI.
customer.startHint: Eg adiwenni s tsiregt i tazwara.
customer.chatEmpty: Iznan ttbanen dagi. Imeḍya n AI d asumer kan; ulac sellek neɣ asnifel n umiḍan.
customer.voiceStreamNote: Taɣect n iminig tettwazen ɣer umessuf; OpsCore ur yini ara tḥerrez taɣect taẓeṭṭaṭ.
customer.voiceRequirement: Taɣect n iminig tessra HTTPS, amaṣwaṛ, tasiregt, tamuddemt Realtime d tigejdit. Mači tilifun.

queue.title: Izirig n ufesri
queue.description: Idiwenniyen n tazɣelt neɣ win yeṭṭfen amdan ttbanen dagi. Izirig d asuter, mači tuqqna.
queue.replyStorageNote: Tiririyin n umdan ttwawḍent, ttbanent deg uḍris n udiwenni.
queue.resolveNote: Yettwafakk s ufus n umxeddim yettwafken.

boundaries.title: Tilisa n twuriwin
boundaries.automateBody: Tiririt tazwara s waṭas n tutlayin, ussugen, asḥiggel n tazɣelt, aḥraz n iḍrisen d usnulfu n izirig.
boundaries.humanBody: Asuter n umdan, laman d ameẓẓyan, tazɣelt tameqqrant, asaḍ n ulac, anamek ur yefri, ckeyyel n waddud.
boundaries.notEnabledTitle: Ur yezmir ara s uferdis-a kan
boundaries.notEnabledBody: PSTN/SIP, WhatsApp, imayl, tilifun, CRM d usenqed n tutlayin ssrin amessuf n tidet d iseɣtiyen.

messages.qualificationNotice: Ulac tutlayt yettwaqbalen alamma iseɣtiyen n uḍris, ASR, TTS d taɣect ffen.
messages.configOk: Awḍan llant. Tuqqna d taɣara n tutlayt ssrint iseɣtiyen n tidet.
messages.conversationCreated: Adewenni s tɣellist yettwaxdem. Taɣara n tutlayt ur tettwaqbal ara.
messages.handoffQueued: Ufesri ɣer umdan yettwafk deg uzirig ({reason}). D asuter, mači tuqqna.
messages.aiResponseFailed: Tiririt n AI ur tefrik ara. Ulac tawuri yettwaxdem. Tzemreḍ ad tsutreḍ amdan.
messages.apiUnavailable: API n udiwenni ur yettwafin ara. Kcem ɣer OpsCore, syin ales asebter-a.
messages.handoffQueuedQueueOnly: Ufesri yettwafk deg uzirig ({reason}). Izirig ur yebin ara amxeddim yella.
messages.voiceHandoffStopped: Ufesri yettwafk deg uzirig. Adiwenni AI yeṛṛeḥ; tilifun ur yettwawḍen ara.
messages.voiceCredentialRequest: Yessuter tigejdit n taɣect n umenzu…
messages.voiceRealtimeError: Amessuf Realtime yebder tuccḍa. Seṛṛeḥ taɣect, ɛayen awḍan, syin ales.
messages.voiceActive: Adewenni n taɣect yetteddu. Suter amdan melmi, wadi d izirig, mači tilifun.

errors.SERVER_RESPONSE_INVALID: Tiririt n uqeddac ur tettwaqra ara.
errors.CONTACT_CENTER_REALTIME_CONNECT_FAILED: Amessuf n taɣect Realtime ur yettwafin ara.
errors.BROWSER_REALTIME_VOICE_UNSUPPORTED: Aminig-a ur yessefrak ara taɣect Realtime.
